name: Global Prehistory
description: Humanity's earliest artistic expressions across Africa, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific.

name: Ancient Mediterranean
description: Art and architecture of the Ancient Near East, Egypt, Greece, Etruria, and Rome.

name: Early Europe and Colonial Americas
description: Late Antique, Medieval, Renaissance, Baroque, and colonial transatlantic traditions.

name: Later Europe and the Americas
description: Neoclassicism, Romanticism, Realism, Impressionism, Modernism, and Postmodernism.

name: Indigenous Americas
description: Ancient Mesoamerica, the Andes, and Native North American cultural traditions.

name: Africa
description: Royal, spiritual, performance, and utilitarian arts of historic African civilizations.

name: West and Central Asia
description: Islamic art, Persian miniature traditions, monumental architecture, and Central Asian crossroads.

name: South, East, and Southeast Asia
description: Buddhist, Hindu, Jain, Daoist, Confucian, and Shinto arts across the Asian continent.

name: The Pacific
description: Oceanic arts of Polynesia, Micronesia, Melanesia, and Aboriginal Australia.

name: Global Contemporary
description: Contemporary art addressing globalization, identity, technology, and memory across the world.
